name: Takamoto Miyuki
source:
She has been married for three years and has a cheerful and vivacious personality. She is always patting her slightly timid and gentle husband on the back and giving him good motivation. She has always been a leader in a group and takes good care of others.

She also likes to take care of others and to be depended on to take care of others. The more difficult a child is to take care of, the cuter she thinks he is.

Although she liked working, she wanted to support her husband who was working very hard, so she “chose to become a full-time housewife, partly because her husband wanted her to.

She is now a housewife, so she must support her husband by becoming a first-rate housewife! She is positively committed to being a housewife.

As time goes by, their married life together becomes less and less, and she is becoming increasingly frustrated with her womanly body.
